scope.dependencyResolution: TypeScript may parse imported files outside the root set; queries and returned source locations are restricted to eligible root files
scope.policy: recursive TS/JS source only; excludes node_modules, test, tests, and __tests__ path segments; does not execute code or install target-repository dependencies

outputPolicy.declarationSlice: AST declaration starts at range.start and ends at shownThroughLine; fullEndLine/range.end remain exact when the slice is truncated

limits: dynamic import, eval, reflection, runtime registration/configuration, and external unresolved modules are not proven
source scope policy can omit callers outside the chosen directory
